summary: Churchill Capital Corp XIII, a Cayman Islands blank-check company, filed an 8-K on September 16, 2026 announcing that holders of its IPO units may elect to separately trade the Class A ordinary shares and warrants beginning September 18, 2026. Units remain trading on Nasdaq under XIIIU, while shares and warrants trade under XIII and XIIIW; separation requires broker contact with transfer agent Continental Stock Transfer & Trust, and only whole warrants trade. No price, stake, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated, and no business combination has been announced. Watch for unit-separation arbitrage dislocations and any future deal or liquidation timeline, with warrant $11.50 exercise overhang and trust-redemption economics as key angles.
